simple.summary: רָכַס (râkaç) means to tie First listed occurrence: Exod 28 28.

definitions.full: H7405. rakas [ רָכַס ] verb bind (Assyrian rakâsu , id.; Late Hebrew found, lay foundation (rare); Arabic bind with [rope tying camel's head to forefoot] (Frey); but usually turn over, reverse (Lane)); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural יִרְכְּסוּ (P) Exod 28:28 , וַיִּרְכְּסוּ 39:21 , bind חשֶׁן by ( מִן ) its rings to ( אֶל ) rings of ephod.
